rules: A row may only be added when the figure came from an authorised first-party report. A number estimated, modelled or remembered does not belong here.
Every row carries a dated provenance trail: who produced the report, when, and where it came from.
Reported orders are entered only from the account's own commission report. A click is never promoted to an order.
No conversion score, click-through rate, revenue forecast or earnings projection is derived from this ledger and published on this site.
Rows may be corrected, never silently overwritten. A correction adds a dated note to the row.

columns.label: Timestamp
columns.description: When the observation was taken, in UTC.

columns.label: Source / provenance
columns.description: The named first-party report or dashboard the figure came from, with a link or document reference.

columns.label: Channel
columns.description: How the session arrived, for example organic search, direct, referral.

columns.label: Eligible sessions
columns.description: Sessions counted under the site's published measurement definition. Blank until an endpoint exists.

columns.label: Clicks
columns.description: Outbound product-link clicks recorded by the site's own first-party counter.

columns.label: Reported orders
columns.description: Orders reported by the Associates commission report. Never inferred from a click.
